name: corrections-v1
description: A scripted first-person chat between Riley and an assistant over four sessions, written to show what PRME stores and returns when a user corrects themselves: a changed plan (Austin, then Denver), a wrong fact fixed in a later session (Jo's birthday, March 3 then March 13) and two conflicting statements in one session (black coffee, oat milk). Riley being a nurse is a control fact that no correction touches.

turns.text: Hi, I'm Riley. I work as an ER nurse in Seattle, mostly night shifts.
Nice to meet you, Riley. Night shifts in an ER sound intense. How can I help?
Big news: I'm planning to move to Austin this summer. A hospital there offered me a day-shift position.
Congratulations! Day shifts could be a real change of pace.
Also, my sister Jo's birthday is March 3. Can you remind me to send her something before then?
Of course. I'll keep your sister's birthday in mind so you can plan a gift.
I'm trying to cut back on sugar. I drink my coffee black, always have.
That makes cutting sugar easier. Any other habits you want to change?
Not really. Though honestly, I take oat milk in my coffee every morning.
Got it. Let me know if you want ideas for lower-sugar breakfasts.
Change of plans: I turned down the Austin job. We're moving to Denver instead, and I start at a hospital there in July.
That's a big decision. Do you want help planning the move?
Yes, soon. And sorry, I gave you Jo's birthday wrong last time. It's actually March 13.
Thanks for the correction. I'll remember that.
Work has been busy. I'm still on night shifts at the ER until the move.
Hang in there. July is not far off.

probes.question: What does Riley do for work?

corrections.label: Riley plans to move to Austin, then chooses Denver
Jo's birthday is given as March 3, then corrected to March 13 in a later session
Riley says black coffee and oat milk in the same session
Riley is a nurse; no correction touches it
